bio.text: June Goodband is a candidate for Governor of Vermont on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot, listed as a member of the Green Mountain Peace and Justice Party of Vermont.

According to information she submitted to Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey on July 1, 2024, she was born in Ithaca, New York, earned a bachelor's degree from Goddard College in 1976 and a graduate degree from Antioch University in 1987.
The same submission lists her career experience as working as a therapist and teacher.
